name: RealEstateAPI
tagline: Expressive property data APIs for building proptech.
description: RealEstateAPI (REAPI) is a developer-focused property data platform offering APIs for property search, detail, comparables, parcel boundaries, address autocomplete, and skip tracing across roughly 95% of U.S. properties. It targets proptech startups and data-heavy products that want flexible, modern access to nationwide real estate data, and provides lender-grade automated valuations with confidence scoring for pre-qualification, underwriting, and portfolio monitoring.
edge: One developer-friendly API set spanning search, comps, parcel boundaries, autocomplete, and skip tracing — not separate single-purpose endpoints.

references.title: RealEstateAPI and the Rise of AI-Native Real Estate Infrastructure
